I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date because nothing Pree can see mentions Brackenwater Freight Co.:

- **Files:** the shared files have no account folder for Brackenwater.
- **Channels:** I read #central-team, which has nothing about them, and I didn't search beyond the channels she's in.
- **Team notes:** the two Central team summary notes don't mention them either.

I told her I've noted the date as unconfirmed and won't treat it as the real renewal date. Whoever owns the account should check it against the contract or the customer record before it goes into any tracker. I also offered to compare the two if she tells me where the account record is kept. I didn't record the date anywhere else, send any mail or ask anyone for approval.
